description: Source code for accelerometer hardware interface and initialization, specifically for STM32F4Discovery with LIS302DL MEMS accelerometer, including SPI configuration and thread-based data reading.

methods.name: configureAccelerometerPins
methods.description: Configures GPIO pins for SPI communication with the accelerometer.

methods.name: initAccelerometer
methods.description: Initializes the accelerometer hardware, SPI interface, and starts data acquisition thread.

methods.name: getLongitudinalAcceleration
methods.description: Returns the current longitudinal acceleration value.

methods.name: getTransverseAcceleration
methods.description: Returns the current transverse acceleration value.
